title: A Token/KV-Cache Communication Media Selection and Resource Allocation Strategy for Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Lipeng Dai; Luping Xiang; Kun Yang
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Novel Software Technology at Nanjing University, Institute of Intelligent Networks and Communications (NINE) at Nanjing University (Suzhou Campus)

problem_statement.en: Token-based communication limits network payload but forces receiver-side prefill and token generation, whereas KV-cache transfer bypasses redundant prefill but sends large tensors over constrained, stochastic wireless links. Because task size, compute capacity, and channel conditions vary, neither medium uniformly minimizes E2E latency in embodied multi-agent systems.
problem_statement.zh: token-based communication 可限制網路 payload，卻要求 receiver 執行 prefill 與 token generation；KV-cache transfer 可略過冗餘 prefill，但須經由受限且具隨機性的 wireless link 傳輸大型 tensor。由於任務規模、運算能力與 channel condition 持續變動，兩種 medium 均無法在 embodied multi-agent system 中一致地使 E2E latency 最小化。

key_innovation.en: The JMSRA framework analytically models marginal computation and wireless latency for token and KV-cache transmission, derives a per-link bandwidth threshold for mode switching, and jointly selects each agent's medium and bandwidth. It solves the resulting mixed-integer nonlinear program with bidirectional greedy mode search and bisection-based bandwidth allocation.
key_innovation.zh: JMSRA framework 以 analytical model 描述 token 與 KV-cache transmission 的邊際運算及 wireless latency，推導單一 link 的 mode-switching bandwidth threshold，並聯合選擇各 agent 的 communication medium 與 bandwidth。其以雙向 greedy mode search 及 bisection-based bandwidth allocation 求解所形成的 mixed-integer nonlinear program。

baselines_compared: All-NL (average allocation), All-KV (average allocation), All-NL (optimized allocation), All-KV (optimized allocation)

key_improvements.en: With 20 assistant agents and a 5-TFLOPS executive agent, JMSRA selects KV mode for 18 assistants and reaches 23.54 s marginal latency, about 75% below All-NL (>90 s) and below All-KV (~41 s). With a 35-TFLOPS executive agent, it adapts toward NL and reaches 13.05 s versus ~13.5 s for All-NL and ~41 s for All-KV.
key_improvements.zh: 在 20 個 assistant agents 與 5-TFLOPS executive agent 的設定下，JMSRA 為其中 18 個 assistants 選擇 KV mode，將 marginal latency 降至 23.54 s；相較 All-NL (>90 s) 約降低 75%，且低於 All-KV (~41 s)。當 executive agent 具備 35 TFLOPS 時，系統轉而偏向 NL，達到 13.05 s，優於 All-NL 的約 13.5 s 與 All-KV 的約 41 s。
